composites.name: sepsis_sbml
composites.description: The BioGears sepsis core as its SBML/Antimony extraction (Sauro), run via Tellurium / roadrunner. Emits the 9 shared comparison observables (SBP, DBP, MAP, HR, CO, SVR, blood volume, tissue integrity, blood pathogen). Infection is seeded from `severity` at t = infection_start_s. Healthy at severity 0.

severity.description: 0 none / 1 mild / 2 moderate / 3 severe (seeds tissue pathogen)

infection_start_s.description: Infection start time in seconds (applied only when severity > 0)

composites.name: sepsis_sbml_eventfree_valve
composites.description: Event-free (proto_valve) reduction of the BioGears sepsis core: the same SBML model with the per-beat E_beat event and piecewise pulOpen valve replaced by a continuous phase oscillator + per-artery valve gating. Runs via Tellurium / roadrunner, emits the same 9 shared comparison observables (SBP, DBP, MAP, HR, CO, SVR, blood volume, tissue integrity, blood pathogen), and keeps the infection events — a ~1.3x faster, per-beat-faithful (~0.2 mmHg) arm for the comparison studies. Healthy at severity 0.

severity.description: 0 none / 1 mild / 2 moderate / 3 severe (seeds tissue pathogen)

infection_start_s.description: Infection start time in seconds (applied only when severity > 0)

composites.name: sepsis_cosim
composites.description: Closed-loop sepsis CO-SIMULATION: the Tellurium sepsis physiology engine and an antibiotic-PK controller process exchange state every tick. The controller senses bacteremia (PB), infuses an antibiotic with a one-compartment PK, and writes the drug-killed pathogen (PT/PB) back into the engine via its parameters_in port. treat=False disables the controller for the matched untreated control.

treat.description: True = closed-loop antibiotic; False = matched untreated control

start_time_s.description: Earliest treatment onset (0 = early; larger = delayed)
